calendarNotes: LPS starts kindergarten, grade 6 and grade 9 on August 10, then starts grades 1–5, 7–8 and 10–12 on August 11. The calendar prints 175 student days across four quarters and 189 teacher contract days. September 6–7 is a no-school period that includes Labor Day and a September 7 building professional learning/planning day. Quarter 1 ends October 8; Quarter Break runs October 11–13, with October 13 identified as a district professional learning/planning day, and Quarter 2 begins October 14. Thanksgiving closure runs November 24–29, with November 29 used for building professional learning/planning. Semester Break runs December 22–January 3, with January 3 identified as a compensatory day, and Quarter 3 begins January 4. Presidents Day closure runs February 21–22, with February 22 used for district professional learning/planning; Spring Break runs March 13–17. March 27 is both a Quarter Break date and a building professional learning/planning day. The PDF says the calendar is subject to revision, so families should recheck LPS after weather or district changes.

customSections.label: What Changes from LPS 2026–27 to 2027–28?
customSections.content: The transition-grade opening falls on Aug. 10 instead of Aug. 12, while the last student day falls on May 18 instead of May 20. LPS still starts kindergarten, grade 6 and grade 9 one day before the remaining grades. Version 2.3 also lists 175 student days and 189 teacher contract days and distinguishes building professional learning, district professional learning and compensatory days.

customSections.label: Why the 2027–28 Calendar Uses Several No-School Labels
customSections.content: Students do not attend on any date below. LPS separately identifies the staff purpose for six dates, including building-level and districtwide professional learning/planning days and a Jan. 3 compensatory day. These labels explain the staff purpose of dates that are already part of a student no-school period.

customSections.label: LPS 2028 Graduation Planning
customSections.content: The calendar reserves May 19–21 for comprehensive high-school graduation at Pinnacle Bank Arena. Yankee Hill, Independence Academy and Bryan Community Focus Program dates are still marked TBA, so families should wait for the applicable program announcement before planning around a specific ceremony date.

calendarFaqs.q: Do all LPS students start on August 10?
calendarFaqs.a: Kindergarten, grade 6 and grade 9 start Tuesday, August 10, 2027. Grades 1–5, 7–8 and 10–12 start Wednesday, August 11.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are on the LPS 2027–28 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official Version 2.3 calendar lists 175 student days: 42 in Quarter 1, 45 in Quarter 2, 46 in Quarter 3 and 42 in Quarter 4.

calendarFaqs.q: Why do October 13 and January 3 have more than one calendar meaning?
calendarFaqs.a: Students are out on both dates, but LPS also identifies the staff purpose. October 13 is the final day of Quarter Break and a district professional learning/planning day; January 3 is the final day of Semester Break and a compensatory day.

calendarFaqs.q: When are LPS high school graduations in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The comprehensive high-school ceremonies at Pinnacle Bank Arena are scheduled for May 19–21, 2028. Program graduation dates remain TBA on the current PDF.
